notes: Piano Spark is now also available for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) as a beta. Download it from the website.
The Mac and Windows apps now share the same lesson engine; lessons on the Mac are created exactly as before.

en: Piano Spark is now also available for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) as a beta. Download it from the website.
The Mac and Windows apps now share the same lesson engine; lessons on the Mac are created exactly as before.
tr: Piano Spark artık Windows 10 ve 11 (64-bit) için de beta olarak var. Web sitesinden indirebilirsin.
Mac ve Windows uygulamaları artık aynı ders motorunu kullanıyor; Mac'te dersler eskisi gibi oluşturulur.
